tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. tools.name: Skill
tools.description:

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

content.text:
下面是把这条简历 bullet 的每一项**逐句映射到 `ins_live_broadcast` 仓库中的真实源码位置**（相对于 `ins_live_broadcast/` 根目录），面试答疑时可以直接引到具体文件和行号：

---

### ① "通过 IBus 总线暴露 Prepare、Start、Stop 等核心接口"

**RPC Server 实现（薄代理层）**

| 接口 | 文件：行号 |
|---|---|
| `LiveBroadcastPrepare` | `src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:22` |
| `LiveBroadcastStart` | `src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:34` |
| `LiveBroadcastStop`（带 `LiveBroadcastStopReason`） | `src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:46` |
| `LiveBroadcastGetState` | `src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:59` |
| `LiveBroadcastResume` | `src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:74` |
| `LiveBroadcastDiscardResume` | `src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:86` |

- 类声明（继承 ERPC 生成的 `LiveBroadcastLiveBroadcastInterface`）：`src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.h:34-48`
- 每个函数都是"判空 `live_broadcast_manager` → `ILOGS_E` → 转发 Manager"的三行薄代理，**无任何业务逻辑/无锁**——这就是"服务端防御性代理"的代码证据。

**Manager 侧异步受理（RPC 契约的实际承接）**
- `src/manager/live_broadcast_manager.cc`：`LiveBroadcastRequestStart` / `LiveBroadcastRequestStop` / `LiveBroadcastRequestResume` ——内部通过 `work_msg_looper_->PostAndWaitResponse<InsErrorCode>(MessageIds::kDispatchStart, ...)` 投递给状态机线程，拿到"已受理"结果立刻返回，`Success ≠ 已连通`。

**4 个服务原子注册（main 入口）**
- `src/main.cc:53-71`：把 `LiveBroadcastLiveBroadcastServer` + `ConfigSubscriber` + `NetdSubscriber` + `MediadSubscriber` 打包进 `ibus_services` 向量，一次 `IbusService::Initialize(std::move(ibus_services), nullptr)` 完成注册（`nullptr` = ibus 分配动态地址，对应知识库里"枚举偏移 → 动态地址初始化"排障故事）。

---

### ② "订阅 configd、netd、mediad 主题实现状态联动"

| 订阅者 | 类声明 | 回调实现 | 订阅的 Topic |
|---|---|---|---|
| Config | `src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.h:62-70` | `.cc:106-117` `OnTopicConfigUpdateInfo` → `manager->OnConfigUpdate(changed_configs)` | `ConfigUpdateInfo` |
| Netd | `.h:84-97` | `.cc:127-160` `OnTopicWifiStaOn` / `OnTopicWifiStaConnect` / `OnTopicWifiStaAutoConnect` / `OnTopicWifiStaOff` → `manager->OnNetd*` | Wi-Fi STA 全生命周期 |
| Mediad | `.h:105-117`（`MediadSubscriber`） | `.cc:158-184` `OnTopicRecordState` / `OnTopicRecordAbnormal` → `manager->OnMediad*` | 录像状态/异常 |

- 回调里全部只做"解包 → 转 Manager"，Manager 内再 Post 到 `work_msg_looper_`——**通信线程零阻塞**的代码证据就在这几个函数只有 3~5 行。
- 配置热更新承接：`src/controller/config_manager.cc`（`OnConfigUpdate` → `ConfigManager` 更新 `LiveBroadcastConfig::rtmp_address` 等）；网络承接：`src/controller/network_controller.cc`；续播承接：`src/controller/resume_manager.cc`。

---

### ③ "基于共享内存同步直播状态，支撑 GUI 高频查询、规避 RPC 开销"

- **写者入口**：`src/manager/live_broadcast_manager.cc` 中 `NotifyStateChanged()` 在每次状态机 `OnEntry` 末尾被调用——同一函数内**同时**做两件事：发布 `LiveBroadcastStateChanged` Topic + 更新 POSIX 共享内存 `/dev/shm/ins_livecast_state`（原子写 `current_state` / `duration_sec` / `kbps` / `fps` / `update_ts_ms`）。
- **秒级刷新源**：`src/timer/duration_timer.cc` + `src/timer/duration_timer.h`——`DurationTimer` 周期 tick，驱动 `duration_sec` 与 `update_ts_ms` 在共享内存中 +1，这正是 GUI 60Hz 轮询读到时长跳动的原因。
- **写权限由进程名背书**：`src/main.cc:38-39` 把 `LOG_TAG` 设为 `"ins_livecast"`，注释明确写"与进程名保持一致，便于日志检索和 ShareState 权限匹配"——`/proc/comm` 15 字符限制对应二进制名 `ins_live_broadcast` → 注册名 `ins_livecast`。

**配套"通知另一个方向"的代码**
- 对外发布 `LiveBroadcastStateChanged` Topic 的实现在 Manager 层 `NotifyStateChanged` 同一路径；App/CLI 用 `ins_ibus_cli subscribe-register kCamera kLiveBroadcast LiveBroadcastStateChanged` 订阅。

---

### ④ 顺带定位这条 bullet 隐含的几个"深水区"源码点

| 知识点 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 双 Looper（main/work 分离） | `main.cc` 主线程只轮询 `running` 标志（`main.cc:99-111`）；`work_msg_looper_` 在 `LiveBroadcastService::Init`/`Manager` 中创建，声明于 `src/manager/live_broadcast_manager.h:163-186` |
| `PostAndWaitResponse` 同步受理 | `src/manager/live_broadcast_manager.cc` 中 `Request*` 系列函数 |
| `attempt_id` 代次防踩踏 | `src/state_machine/live_state_starting.cc:63-79`（Starting 进入时生成 attempt）；`manager.cc` 中 `active_start_attempt_` 校验丢弃过期连接结果 |
| 15s 超时 Join + Detach | `src/state_machine/live_state_stopping.cc:46` 附近 + `manager.cc` 连接线程回收函数 |
| 状态机基类默认拦截 | `src/state_machine/live_state_base.cc` / `.h`（所有事件默认打警告并返回非法态） |

---

### 一句话图谱

```
外部/内部调用
    │
    ▼
src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc  (6 个 RPC 薄代理 + 3 个 Subscriber)
    │  判空 → 转发
    ▼
src/manager/live_broadcast_manager.cc (Request* → PostAndWaitResponse → work_msg_looper_)
    │
    ├──► src/state_machine/*            状态机 OnEntry/事件分流
    │         └─► NotifyStateChanged() ─► ShareState(/dev/shm/ins_livecast_state) + Topic
    │                                      ▲ src/timer/duration_timer.cc（秒级 tick 写时长）
    ├──► src/controller/network_controller.cc  ← NetdSubscriber 回调落地
    ├──► src/controller/config_manager.cc      ← ConfigSubscriber 回调落地
    └──► src/controller/resume_manager.cc      ← 断电续播承接
```

**面试技巧**：被问到任何一句，先报"动作"，再报"文件"，最后抛一个细节数字（15 字符 comm、60Hz、单写多读、attempt_id 递增、15s 超时 join）。比如"Stop 接口在 `src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:46`，只转发到 Manager 的 `RequestStop`，再由 `work_msg_looper_` 串行驱动状态机——响应在微秒级，真正断流交给 Stopping 状态的四阶段管线"。

是的，6 个接口都已完整实现，而且是"三层落实"（RPC 薄代理 → Manager 投递 → 状态机白名单事件）。下面是每个接口的**逐层代码落点**：

---

### 1. `LiveBroadcastPrepare`

| 层 | 位置 | 做的事 |
|---|---|---|
| RPC 入口 | `src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:22-32` | `LiveBroadcastLiveBroadcastServer::LiveBroadcastPrepare()` → 判空 Manager → `manager->LiveBroadcastPrepare()` |
| Manager 投递 | `src/manager/live_broadcast_manager.cc:506-515` | `LiveBroadcastPrepare()` → `work_msg_looper_->PostAndWaitResponse<InsErrorCode>(kDispatchPrepare, 0)` —— 在通信线程拿到"受理结果"即返回 |
| 工作线程核检 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:569-580` `OnDispatchPrepare` | 校验 `state ∈ {Idle, Prepare}`，否则 `kEinval`；通过则 `DispatchEvent(EventPrepareRequest{})` |
| 状态机承接 | `src/state_machine/live_state_idle.cc:31`（Idle 重写 `OnEvent(EventPrepareRequest)`） | 进 `Prepare` 态；`live_state_prepare.cc:24` `OnEntry` 做配置校验与拉起 Wi-Fi |

### 2. `LiveBroadcastStart`

| 层 | 位置 | 做的事 |
|---|---|---|
| RPC 入口 | `src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:34-44` | `LiveBroadcastStart()` → `manager->LiveBroadcastRequestStart()` |
| Manager 投递 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:517-526` | `PostAndWaitResponse(kDispatchStart)` |
| 工作线程核检 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:582-593` `OnDispatchStart` | 必须 `state == Prepare`，否则 `kEinval`；构造 `EventStartRequest{rtmp_url = config_manager_->GetRtmpUrl()}` 派发 |
| 状态机承接 | `live_state_prepare.cc:33` `OnEvent(EventStartRequest)` → 转 `Starting`；`live_state_starting.cc:30` `OnEntry` 里 `NewStartAttempt()` 生成 attempt_id 并起 `connect_thread_` 做 RTMP 握手 |

### 3. `LiveBroadcastStop`

| 层 | 位置 | 做的事 |
|---|---|---|
| RPC 入口 | `src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:46-57` | `LiveBroadcastStop(LiveBroadcastStopReason reason)` → `manager->LiveBroadcastRequestStop(reason)` |
| Manager 投递 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:528-538` | `PostAndWaitResponse(kDispatchStop, static_cast<int32_t>(stop_reason))` |
| 工作线程核检 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:595-609` `OnDispatchStop` | `Idle → kEinval`；`Stopping → kEalready`（防双击）；其余态构造 `EventStopRequest{reason}` 派发 |
| 状态机承接 | 各状态重写 `OnEvent(EventStopRequest)`：Idle 无（基类拦截）、`live_state_prepare.cc:67`、`live_state_starting.cc:125`、`live_state_running.cc:43` → 全部转 `Stopping`；`live_state_stopping.cc` 的 `OnEntry` 做四阶段关停 + 15s 超时 Join/Detach |

### 4. `LiveBroadcastGetState`

| 层 | 位置 | 做的事 |
|---|---|---|
| RPC 入口 | `src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:59-72` | `LiveBroadcastGetState(LiveBroadcastStateInfo&)` → `manager->GetLiveBroadcastState(state_info)` |
| Manager 读取 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:540-546` | `AutoMutex lock(state_mutex_)`；填 `state_info.state = current_state_`、`state_info.error_code = current_error_` —— **同步读返回**，这是 6 个接口里唯一"回值立即可用"的 |

### 5. `LiveBroadcastResume`

| 层 | 位置 | 做的事 |
|---|---|---|
| RPC 入口 | `live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:74-84` | → `manager->LiveBroadcastRequestResume()` |
| Manager 投递 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:548-557` | `PostAndWaitResponse(kDispatchResume)` |
| 工作线程核检 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:611-620` `OnDispatchResume` | 必须 `Idle`，否则 `kEinval`；派发 `EventResume{}` |
| 状态机承接 | `live_state_idle.cc:39` `OnEvent(EventResume)` → 加载续播记录 → 转 `Prepare` |

### 6. `LiveBroadcastDiscardResume`

| 层 | 位置 | 做的事 |
|---|---|---|
| RPC 入口 | `live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:86-96` | → `manager->LiveBroadcastRequestDiscardResume()` |
| Manager 投递 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:559-567` | `PostAndWaitResponse(kDispatchDiscardResume)` |
| 工作线程核检 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:622-631` `OnDispatchDiscardResume` | 必须 `Idle`；派发 `EventDiscardResume{}` |
| 状态机承接 | `live_state_idle.cc:56` `OnEvent(EventDiscardResume)` → 清续播记录，留在 `Idle` |

---

### 附：配套的"结果回传"与"代次防踩踏"代码

| 机制 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| `start_attempt_seq_` 原子自增生代次 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:500-504` `NewStartAttempt()` |
| 连接线程把结果 + attempt_id POST 回工作线程 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:638-650` `PostStartResult(attempt_id, err, msg)` |
| 工作线程丢弃过期结果 | `live_broadcast_manager.cc:652-664` `OnDispatchStartResult`：`payload.attempt_id != active_start_attempt_` 直接 return |
| 状态变更双写（Topic + ShareState） | `NotifyStateChanged()` 在 `live_broadcast_manager.cc` 中由每个 `OnEntry` 末尾调用 |

---

### 一句话总结给面试官

> "这 6 个 RPC 接口都做成了同样的三层结构：`live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc` 里是 3~5 行的判空薄代理；`live_broadcast_manager.cc` 的 `Request*`/`Prepare` 用 `PostAndWaitResponse` 把请求投递给 `work_msg_looper_` 并立刻把受理结果返回；最后在 `live_state_*.cc` 中由状态机基类做白名单拦截，合法状态重写 `OnEvent` 推进状态。其中 `GetState` 是唯一同步回值接口，用 `state_mutex_` + `AutoMutex` 读 `current_state_` 和 `current_error_`；其余 5 个都是异步受理——`Success` 只代表已合法受理。"

这样答就把"接口开发"从空泛的"封装了几个函数"落到了具体的代码文件、行号和异步受理契约上。

content.text:
这条 bullet 实际是整套设计的**核心亮点**，我把它拆成"心智模型图 → 真实链路走一遍 → 三个设计亮点分别怎么体现"来讲，全部锚定到你仓库里的源码：

---

## 一、心智模型：四轨并发，状态机单线程独占

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     ins_livecast 进程                                │
│                                                                      │
│  ┌──────────────────────────┐    ┌───────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  main_msg_looper_         │    │  work_msg_looper_              │   │
│  │  "LiveBroadcastMain"      │    │  "LiveBroadcastWork"           │   │
│  │  (IBus 回调 / 订阅回调)   │    │  ◄─── 状态机唯一宿主线程       │   │
│  │                          │    │   所有 OnEvent/OnEntry/OnExit  │   │
│  │  职责：解包 + 判空 + 转发 │    │   都在此串行执行 → 天然无锁     │   │
│  │  铁律：不做任何耗时操作   │    │                                │   │
│  └────────────┬─────────────┘    └──────────┬────────────────────┘   │
│               │ PostAndWaitResponse / Post  │                          │
│               ▼                             ▼                          │
│  ┌──────────────────────────┐    ┌───────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  connect_thread_          │    │  RtmpPusher push_thread_       │   │
│  │  (RTMP 握手，慢且易阻塞)  │    │  (数据面取帧-FLV封包-发送)     │   │
│  │  携带 attempt_id 回投     │    │  异常时才 POST 回 work_looper  │   │
│  └──────────────────────────┘    └───────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                      │
│  ┌──────────────────────────┐    ┌───────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  StreamReader 读线程      │    │  DurationTimer / LiveMonitor   │   │
│  │  (IpcFrameBuf → Enqueue)  │    │  (秒级 tick / QoS 采集)        │   │
│  └──────────────────────────┘    └───────────────────────────────┘   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
              ▲                                    ▲
              │ IBus (控制面)                       │ ShareState + Topic (状态面)
              │                                    │
        ins_gui / ins_link / App             ins_gui 60Hz 读
```

---

## 二、一条完整链路：用户点"开始直播" → 真正推流

```
App/ins_link
   │  IBus RPC: LiveBroadcastStart()
   ▼
src/ibus/live_broadcast_ibus_impl.cc:34
   │  LiveBroadcastLiveBroadcastServer::LiveBroadcastStart()
   │  → 判空 manager → manager->LiveBroadcastRequestStart()
   ▼
src/manager/live_broadcast_manager.cc:517
   │  LiveBroadcastRequestStart()
   │  → work_msg_looper_->PostAndWaitResponse<InsErrorCode>(kDispatchStart, 0)
   │     【通信线程在这里等~几十 μs】
   ▼
src/manager/live_broadcast_manager.cc:582 OnDispatchStart（工作线程内）
   │  ① 校验 GetCurrentState() == kPrepare？否 → 立即 return kEinval
   │  ② 组装 EventStartRequest{rtmp_url}
   │  ③ LiveStateMachine::DispatchEvent(evt)  → 此刻状态机在工作线程内同步切到 Starting
   │  ④ return kSuccess   ← 这就是 RPC 返回"已受理"的那一刻（毫秒级）
   ▼
src/state_machine/live_state_prepare.cc:33 OnEvent(EventStartRequest)
   │  判 WiFi 连接态 + rtmp_url 非空 → ChangeState<LiveStateStarting>()
   ▼
src/state_machine/live_state_starting.cc:30 OnEntry（仍工作线程）
   │  ① 创建 RtmpPusher、stream_controller_->SwitchToLiveMode()
   │  ② manager_->BeginStartAttempt() → start_attempt_seq_.fetch_add → 得 attempt_id
   │  ③ manager_->StartConnectThread([weak_mgr, pusher, rtmp_url, attempt_id]{...})
   │     【真正的耗时 TCP+RTMP 握手被扔进独立线程】
   │  ④ 工作线程立刻空闲，继续消化下一个事件
   ▼
connect_thread_（独立线程，脱离状态机）
   │  pusher->Connect(rtmp_url)  ── 阻塞 3~10s
   │  结束后：mgr->PostStartResult(attempt_id, err, msg)
   ▼
src/manager/live_broadcast_manager.cc:652 OnDispatchStartResult（回到工作线程）
   │  ① 读 active_start_attempt_（acquire）与 payload.attempt_id 比对
   │     → 不一致 = 过期结果，直接丢弃（这就是"防踩踏"）
   │  ② GetCurrentState() != kStarting → 丢弃
   │  ③ err == Success → DispatchEvent(EventStartSuccess)
   ▼
src/state_machine/live_state_starting.cc:91 OnEvent(EventStartSuccess)
   │  ChangeState<LiveStateRunning>()
   ▼
src/state_machine/live_state_running.cc:22 OnEntry
   │  StartLiveBroadcastDurationTimer + StartLiveBroadcastMonitor + SaveConnectedWifiSsid
   │  → 同时 NotifyStateChanged()：写 ShareState + 发 LiveBroadcastStateChanged Topic
   ▼
ins_gui 从 /dev/shm/ins_livecast_state 纳秒级读到 Running
DurationTimer 每 1s 把 duration_sec +1 → GUI 时长实时跳动
```

**关键点**：RPC 从"收到请求"到"返回 `kSuccess`"只走了 ②④ 两步——**根本没有等 RTMP 握手**。真正网络 I/O 发生在另一条线程里，靠 `attempt_id` 回传结果。

---

## 三、三个设计亮点逐一对照

### ① "五态转换"——每个状态是一个类，不是 if-else

| 状态 | 文件 | 进入动作（OnEntry） | 主要离开条件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idle` | `live_state_idle.cc` | 待命 | `EventPrepareRequest` → Prepare；`EventResume` → Prepare（续播）；`EventDiscardResume` → 留 Idle |
| `Prepare` | `live_state_prepare.cc` | 校验配置、配网 | `EventStartRequest`/`EventPrepareComplete` → Starting；`EventStopRequest`/`EventCancel` → Idle |
| `Starting` | `live_state_starting.cc` | 建 pusher、生成 `attempt_id`、起 `connect_thread_` | `EventStartSuccess` → Running；`EventStartFailed` → Prepare；`EventStopRequest`/`EventError` → Stopping |
| `Running` | `live_state_running.cc` | 启 `DurationTimer`+`LiveMonitor`+存 Wi-Fi SSID | `EventStopRequest`/`EventError` → Stopping（先判 `ShouldSaveResumeRecord`） |
| `Stopping` | `live_state_stopping.cc` | 四阶段关停 + 15s 超时 Join/Detach 连接线程 | `EventStopComplete` → Idle |

### ② "基类默认事件拦截"——白名单式防御

- `src/state_machine/live_state_base.cc:57-111`：每个事件都有默认实现 `ILOGS_W << "Unhandled EventXxx in state: " << Name()` ——**派生类不重写 = 自动拒绝**；
- 实例证据：`Prepare` 收到 `EventStartSuccess`？没重写 → 基类拦截打警告；`Running` 收到 `EventPrepareRequest`？同样被拦；
- 好处一句话：**任何非法时序都不可能触发野跳转或未定义行为**，且日志里立刻能抓到是哪条状态 + 哪个事件越权。

### ③ "双 Looper 模型"——状态机锁根本不存在

- `main_msg_looper_`：IBus RPC 回调 + `Config/Netd/Mediad` 订阅回调落点，只做"解包 + `Post*`"，**永不执行耗时业务**；
- `work_msg_looper_`：状态机的**唯一宿主线程**，所有 `DispatchEvent/OnEntry/OnExit/OnEvent` 都在这里串行执行；
- 同步手段：`PostAndWaitResponse<R>`（`manager.cc:506-567`），底层是 `std::promise`/`future`——通信线程只等工作线程"核验 + 切换决定"那几十 μs；
- 因为状态机只有一个线程在动，**从架构上消灭了 AB-BA 死锁和数据竞态**——这就是"无锁化并发一致性"的真正含义。

### 顺带：两个被高频追问的细节

| 细节 | 源码锚点 |
|---|---|
| `attempt_id` 防旧连接回调踩踏 | `live_state_starting.cc:63` `BeginStartAttempt()`；`manager.cc:500-504` `fetch_add`；`manager.cc:652-664` `OnDispatchStartResult` 比对丢弃 |
| 续播记录的写盘条件 | `live_state_running.cc:88-106` `ShouldSaveResumeRecord`：kUserStop→false；过热/网络/系统/低电/Token/关机→true |

---

## 四、30 秒面试口述版

## 一、维测部分（`ins_livecast_cli`）是怎么做的

基于刚才读到的真实源码（`cli/source/` 目录），维测工具的完整实现有五个关键点：

### ① 进程启动：IBus 动态地址初始化（`cli/source/main.cc:16-31`）

```cpp
InsErrorCode InitializeIbus() {
  INS_IBUS_INIT_INFO_LOG();
  std::vector<std::unique_ptr<::erpc::Service>> services;   // 空服务列表
  InsErrorCode init_result = ::ins::ibus::IbusService::GetInstance()
      .Initialize(std::move(services), nullptr);            // nullptr = 动态地址
  ...
}
```

这是排障故事三的代码落点：CLI 是**非常驻维测进程**，若绑定静态枚举地址，会与设备上其他节点的地址产生版本偏移冲突 → 响应路由错乱 → RPC 全线超时。改为空 service 列表 + `nullptr`，由 ibus 动态分配地址后根治。

### ② REPL 终端：replxx 挂载三回调（`cli/source/cli_terminal.cc:61-95`）

- `set_completion_callback`（:68）：动态补全——命令名 + 子命令词 + stop_reason 关键字；
- `set_hint_callback`（:75）：行内灰色提示；
- `set_highlighter_callback`（:82）：语法高亮（正确 token 亮绿 `BRIGHTGREEN`，参数 `CYAN`）；
- 还有工程细节：`set_max_history_size(100)` 历史持久化、`Ctrl+R` 反向搜索、`Ctrl+L` 清屏、`set_beep_on_error(false)` 静音。

### ③ 命令模式：四个命令注册（`cli/source/command_manager.cc:83-86`）

```cpp
RegisterCommand(std::make_unique<commands::LiveCtrlCommand>());   // 控制类
RegisterCommand(std::make_unique<commands::LiveInfoCommand>());   // 查询类
RegisterCommand(std::make_unique<commands::HelpCommand>());
RegisterCommand(std::make_unique<commands::QuitCommand>());
```

`live_ctrl_command.cc` 里还内置了 **7 种 stop_reason 的枚举表**（`kStopReasonEntries`，:27-35）：`user/overheat/network/system/battery/token/poweroff`——既是 `stop` 命令的必填参数来源，也是 `help` 输出与补全词表的单一事实来源。

### ④ 业务封装：`InsLivecastCli`（`cli/source/ins_livecast_cli.cc`）

这是 CLI 与平台层的桥，两类调用路径：

- **RPC 类**（:14-44）：`LiveBroadcastClient::GetInstance().LiveBroadcastPrepare/Start/Stop/Resume/DiscardResume/GetState`——直接走 IBus 远程客户端，`GetState` 用 `tl::expected<StateInfo, InsErrorCode>` 封装返回值；
- **非 RPC 类**（:46-134）：
  - `SetLiveBroadcastUrl`：URL 校验（`rtmp://`/`rtmps://` 前缀 + `kMaxRtmpAddressLen` 长度）→ `ConfigParamController::SetGeneralConfig<kLiveBroadcast>` 写入 configd → **立即回读校验**（:75-91：readback 后比对，长度不符返回 `kEio`）——"写必校验"防止配置静默失败；
  - `SetConnectWifi`：SSID 非空校验 → 分流 `WifiStaOnNoPasswd`（开放网络）/ `WifiStaOn`（加密网络），CLI 直接作为 IBus 客户端调 **netd** 的接口，把配网动作也纳入命令行。

### ⑤ 容错与人机提示（`live_ctrl_command.cc:53-72`）

```cpp
void PrintRpcFailureHint(InsErrorCode result) {
  if (result == kInsErrorCode_Ibus_Timeout) {
    std::cout << "RPC request timed out. Please check whether ins_livecast "
                 "is running and initialized correctly.\n";
  }
}
// 成功时也明确提示异步语义：
std::cout << action << " request accepted.\n";
std::cout << "请求已受理，请使用 get_state 确认最终状态。\n";   // kStateFollowUpHint
```

这里把**"Success = 已受理 ≠ 已完成"的异步契约**直接内建到 CLI 提示语里，引导操作者用 `get_state` 确认终态——把接口语义从代码层贯彻到了工具层。

#### Q15：如果让你重新设计这个状态机，你觉得哪个地方还能优化？
> **答**：可以引入 **C++17 `std::variant` 与 `std::visit`** 来实现强类型安全的有限状态机。通过类型系统在编译期确保事件与状态匹配的完备性，将一部分运行期的虚函数派发开销进一步优化为编译期的确定性代码；此外可以引入分层状态机（Hierarchical State Machine, HSM），将网络自适应与推流重试细化为 Running 内部的子状态，使架构更加清晰。

---

### 10. 面试 30 秒应答模板
> “在状态机与并发架构上，我们确立了**‘五态确定性拓扑 + 双 Looper 串行无锁模型’**。我们设计了 `LiveStateBase` 统一拦截非法时序，仅在合法子状态开放跳转通道。为了从根本上消除锁竞争与死锁，我们将状态机独占绑定在工作专有线程中，主通信线程通过事件循环进行无锁派发。针对弱网下用户快速连击导致的并发乱序，我们创新性地引入了 `attempt_id` 代次机制，精准识别并秒级丢弃迟到的网络连接结果；在退出时引入‘15s 超时 Join + Detach’降级容灾，彻底根治了推流挂死导致相机无法关机的系统顽疾。”

---

891: #### Q5：如果主直播进程崩溃了，CLI 工具有做防御处理吗？
892: > **答**：有。CLI 内部的所有 IBus 远程调用都设置了显式的连接检测与 3 秒超时限制。如果守护进程挂死或未启动，CLI 会打印出友好的错误信息 `Error: Cannot connect to ins_livecast daemon (No such process or IBus timeout)`，并且在 Linux 层面返回退出码 `ENODEV`，绝不会让终端被挂起。
893: 
894: #### Q6：该工具除了发控制指令，能查看推流状态吗？
895: > **答**：可以。`live_info get_state` 对应 RPC `LiveBroadcastGetState`，同步返回结构体 `LiveBroadcastStateInfo{LiveBroadcastState state, LiveBroadcastErrorCode error_code}`，用于观察 `prepare / start / stop` 各命令执行后的状态迁移与错误码，是维测结论的唯一权威依据（设计上刻意不依赖业务侧 Topic 推送）。另有 `live_info get_time` 预留查询已播时长等时间类信息，当前版本仅占位不实现，留给后续版本扩展。
896: 
897: #### Q7：你们维测工具的代码是如何组织在工程目录中的？
898: > **答**：在工程结构上，维测工具位于 `cli/` 独立子目录，拥有专属的 `CMakeLists.txt`。它与主服务 `src/` 共享相同的头文件定义和 IBus Client 生成代码，但在编译产物上彼此完全独立，生成单独的二进制文件 `ins_livecast_cli`，不会增加主推流服务守护进程的体积。
899: 
900: #### Q8：这个工具最终给项目带来了什么量化的提效收益？
901: > **答**：原本一次跨 App、网络、媒体团队的推流联调问题，从抓包、查日志到定位平均需要 2 到 4 小时；使用板端 CLI 后，底层工程师可以在 30 秒内复现时序、就地验证各模块返回值，**平均排障与联调耗时缩短了 70% 以上**；同时为后续的产线自动化自检提供了现成脚本工具。
902: 
903: #### Q9：开发/联调过程中印象最深的一次跨进程通信排障是什么？

913: ## 五、条目四（扩展数据面与业务全景谈资）：推流管线、FLV封装与弱网自适应
914: 
915: ### 1. 顺便提一嘴的口语概括
916: > “除了控制面的接口、状态机和维测工具，在数据面推流管线中，我们通过零拷贝共享内存从媒体编码层拉流，自主完成了 H.264 NALU 到 FLV 容器的封装与 RTMP 分片组包；针对户外运动弱网环境，设计了 LiveMonitor 网络质量监测模块与动态码率自适应算法，在网络抖动时平滑降额推流。”
917: 
918: ### 2. 背景知识 A：AIPL 媒体数据面设计——从 IpcFrameBuf 共享内存拉流到 NALU 零拷贝解析
919: - **AIPL 媒体数据面与控制面分离**：在 AIPL 平台架构中，音视频媒体数据由于吞吐量大（1080P/4K 直播码流达到数 Mbps 至数十 Mbps）、延迟敏感（毫秒级端到端延迟），严格禁止走 IBus 总线进行序列化传输，而是统一采用 **POSIX 共享内存 + 环形帧缓冲** 机制（`ins_base::IpcFrameBuf` / `IpcRingBuf`）。
920: - **视频帧传递机制**：硬件媒体编码守护进程 `ins_mediad` 独占 Ambarella/Qualcomm SoC 编码硬件，将摄像头采集画面编码为 H.264/H.265 NALU 帧，并写入 `IpcFrameBuf` 共享内存。`IpcFrameBuf` 采用“单写多读（Single-Writer Multi-Reader）”与无锁帧索引环形缓冲设计，写端递增写指针，多个读端（如 `ins_gui` 本地预览、`ins_livecast` 直播推流、`ins_link` 手机 Wi-Fi 预览）根据自身读指针独立拉流。
921: - **独立读取线程与直接入队**：`StreamReader` 分别开辟专属的视频读取线程（`Video Read Thread`）和音频读取线程（`Audio Read Thread`），以阻塞方式直接从 `IpcFrameBuf` 映射内存读取帧数据，并**直接调用 `RtmpPusher::EnqueueFrame`** 送入推流队列，**数据完全不经过 `MsgLooper` 事件循环**，避免消息循环成为数据流瓶颈。
922: - **NALU 边界解析与防御性流式处理**：从共享内存读取到的视频裸流通过 `NaluReader` 进行起始码（`00 00 01` 或 `00 00 00 01`）定位与帧切分，提取 SPS、PPS 参数集与 I/P 帧。为了防止高码率或异常裸流导致内存暴涨，`NaluReader` 内置了 `kMaxPendingSize` 缓冲区硬上界保护，发现异常超限时主动丢弃并报警，保证推流进程的内存稳定性。数据全程基于内存指针映射解析，杜绝用户态与内核态之间的大块数据拷贝。
923: 
924: ### 3. 背景知识 B：FLV Tag 封装（H.264 Video Tag / AAC Audio Tag / Sequence Header）
925: - **FLV 容器结构**：推流前首先组装 `FLV Header`（9 字节），随后交替封装 `Audio Tag` 与 `Video Tag`；RTMP 消息类型上，Video 的 Message Type ID = 9、Audio = 8、Data AMF3 = 16。
926: - **VIDEODATA 帧结构**：`FrameType`（UB[4]，1 = keyframe 可 seek、2 = inter frame、5 = info/command）+ `CodecID`（UB[4]，7 = AVC/H.264）；随后是 `AVCVIDEOPACKET`——`AVCPacketType`（0 = sequence header、1 = NALU、2 = end of sequence）+ `CompositionTime`（SI24，仅 AVCPacketType=1 时为 PTS-CTS 偏移）。
927: - **AVCDecoderConfigurationRecord**：在首帧之前必须发送包含 SPS 与 PPS 的 Sequence Header（`AVCPacketType = 0`），告知接收端解码器初始化参数；NAL 单元按“NAL Unit Header + Payload”格式逐个嵌入后续 `AVCPacketType = 1` 的消息。
928: - **时间戳单调递增**：将绝对系统时间戳转为以毫秒为基准的相对时间戳（以第一帧 PTS 为起始基准），并严密处理 FLV 24位常规时间戳与 8位扩展时间戳（TimestampExtended）的溢出回绕计算。
929: 
930: ### 4. 背景知识 C：RTMP 握手交互（C0/S0/C1/S1/C2/S2）与 Chunk 分片发送机制
931: - **标准握手流程**：
932:   - 客户端发送 C0（版本号 0x03）+ C1（1536 字节时间戳与随机数）；
933:   - 服务端返回 S0 + S1 + S2；
934:   - 客户端校验并回发 C2，完成双向身份验证。
935: - **Chunk Stream 分片**：为了防止大视频帧霸占传输链路导致控制信令和音频延迟，RTMP 协议将 FLV 数据拆分为 Chunk（默认 128 字节，我们调优为 4096 字节以减少头部开销），并设置不同的 Chunk Stream ID（CSID）。
936: 
937: ### 5. 背景知识 D：LiveMonitor 网络质量监控与动态自适应码率调整算法（真实设计）
938: 
939: `LiveMonitor` 由 `NetworkMetrics`（指标采集）+ `BitrateAdaptor`（码率决策）构成，Running 态启动，周期采集后 POST 码率调整事件给 `StreamController` 通知编码器。

941: #### 1. 多因子指标采集
942: | 指标 | 测量方法 | 质量档位与告警阈值 |
943: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
944: | **RTT** | 方案一：定时 Task 对 RTMP 服务器执行 ICMP ping（周期可配置）；方案二：直接读 RTMP 报文头 extended timestamp | 0~50ms 高 / 50~100ms 中 / 100~200ms 低（持续 3s 触发 RTT 告警）/ >200ms 低（持续 1s 触发告警） |
945: | **RTT 抖动** | 以每档位平均 RTT 为基准，每偏移 1ms 记 1 次抖动 | 0~20 高 / 20~30 中 / >30 低（持续 3s 触发抖动告警） |
946: | **链路丢包率** | 定时 ICMP echo/reply 统计 | 0~1% 高 / 1~3% 中 / 3~5% 触发丢包告警 / >5% 触发丢包告警 |
947: | **RSSI（上级 AP）** | 定时获取 STA↔AP 信号强度 | -30~-50dBm 高 / -50~-70 中 / -70~-90 低（持续 3s 告警）/<-90dBm 低（持续 1s 告警） |
948: | **流量统计** | 基于 librtmp 的 socket 收发字节数实时统计，校核实际码率是否匹配配置码率 | 码率偏差 ±10% 为健康带 |
949: | **温度 / 电量** | 机内传感器周期读取 | 温度过高触发降码率或断流；电量不足及时告警 |
950: 
951: #### 2. 加权质量评分（`Ins_Live_Stream_Qos`）
952: ```
953: Qos = rtt_qos × rtt_wt + jitter_qos × jitter_wt + drop_qos × drop_wt + rssi_qos × rssi_wt
954: 权重：RTT 高(30%)、丢包率 高(30%)、RSSI 中(25%)、抖动 低(15%)
955: 质量分数带：高 = 80~100，中 = 60~79，低 = 0~59
956: RTT 分段线性插值示例：≤20ms 记 100 分；20~50ms → 80 + 20×(50-RTT)/30；
957:                      50~100ms → 60 + 19×(100-RTT)/50；100~200ms → 59×(200-RTT)/100；≥200ms 记 0 分
958: ```

先讲**维测部分是怎么做的**（基于刚读完的真实源码），然后把这些内容连同今天讨论的接口层、状态机心智模型一起补进知识库。

---

# 一、维测部分：`ins_livecast_cli` 的真实实现链路

## 1. 启动链路（`cli/source/main.cc`）

```cpp
int main() {
    InitializeIbus();                                    // ① 动态地址初始化
    CommandManager::GetInstance().InitializeCommands();  // ② 注册 4 条命令
    CliTerminal terminal(true);                          // ③ REPL 终端（true=历史持久化）
    while (true) {
        const auto input = terminal.Input("ins-livecast> ");  // ④ 提示符循环
        if (!terminal.HandleLine(input.value())) break;        // ⑤ 解析执行，quit/EOF 退出
    }
}
```

- **① 动态地址**：`Initialize(std::move(services), nullptr)`——空 service 列表 + `nullptr`，由 ibus 分配动态地址，正是知识库排障故事三"枚举偏移导致 RPC 全线超时"的根治方案（`main.cc:16-31`）；
- 进程**非常驻**，测完即退，不占后台资源。

## 2. REPL 终端层（`cli/source/cli_terminal.cc`）

replxx 挂载细节（`cli_terminal.cc:55-96`）：
- `set_max_history_size(100)`、`set_max_hint_rows(4)`；
- **历史持久化**：`$HOME/.config/ins_livecast_cli/history.txt`，`history_load` 启动恢复、`history_sync` 每次输入后落盘——重启 shell 命令不丢；
- **三个回调**：`set_completion_callback`（Tab 补全）、`set_hint_callback`（单行灰色提示，唯一命中绿色）、`set_highlighter_callback`（语法高亮）；
- `set_word_break_characters(" \t\n\r")`——按空白切词做前缀匹配；
- `set_completion_count_cutoff(64)`——超过 64 个候选拒绝补全防刷屏；
- 快捷键绑定：`Ctrl+R` 增量历史搜索、`Ctrl+L` 清屏。

## 3. 命令层（命令模式）

| 命令 | 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|---|
| `live_ctrl` | `commands/live_ctrl_command.cc` | `prepare / start / stop / resume / discard_resume` 下发 + **`set_url` / `set_wifi` 非 RPC 配置命令** |
| `live_info` | `commands/live_info_command.cc` | `get_state` 同步查询，`magic_enum` 把枚举转可读字符串；别名 `get_state` 直接注册 |
| `help` / `quit` | `help_command.cc` / `quit_command.cc` | 用法与退出 |

注册点：`command_manager.cc:83-86` 逐个 `RegisterCommand`。

**两个契约级细节（面试讲点）：**
1. **Stop 强制带原因**：`kStopReasonEntries` 7 元表（`user/overheat/network/system/battery/token/poweroff`），少参数直接打 usage（`live_ctrl_command.cc:27-35`、`:862-867` 知识库片段）——契约上不允许默认值；
2. **异步受理提示**：成功后打印 `"request accepted"` + `"请求已受理，请使用 get_state 确认最终状态"`（`live_ctrl_command.cc:18-19`、`:61-73`）——CLI 的输出文案本身就承载了"Success ≠ 完成"的语义契约；`kInsErrorCode_Ibus_Timeout` 时提示 "check whether ins_livecast is running"（`:53-59`）。

## 4. Facade 层（`cli/source/ins_livecast_cli.cc`）

- **6 个 RPC 透传**：直接调 `LiveBroadcastClient::GetInstance().LiveBroadcast*()`（IDL 生成的单例 Client）（`:14-44`）；
- **`set_url` 防御性写入**（`:46-94`）：`Trim` → `ValidateRtmpUrl`（必须 `rtmp://` 或 `rtmps://` 前缀 + `< kMaxRtmpAddressLen`）→ `ConfigParamController::SetGeneralConfig<kLiveBroadcast>` 写 configd → **回读比对**（写完必须读回来和输入一致，不一致返回 `kInsErrorCode_Comm_Eio`）——"写后读校验"防御配置链路；
- **`set_wifi` 直连 netd**（`:96-111`）：有密码走 `WifiStaOn`、无密码走 `WifiStaOnNoPasswd`，`OperateOwner::kLive`、`OperateMode::kAsync`——绕过直播进程直接配网，用于单独验证网络链路。

## 5. 维测价值一句话

> CLI 把直播全生命周期（配网→开播→停播→续播→状态核验）压缩进一个 REPL：每条命令对应一个可断言的返回码，状态用 `get_state` 权威回读，配置写入带读回校验——**同一命令序列既能人肉交互也能管道灌入做 CI 回归**。

632	### 9. 面试问答汇总（15 问深度技术交锋）
633	
634	#### Q1：为什么你们状态机要设计成五个状态？四个状态（少一个 Prepare）不行吗？
635	> **答**：绝对不行。`Prepare` 状态的存在体现了工业级设计的严谨性。在推流之前，相机需要完成两项前置重任：第一是向 `configd` 查询校验推流地址并解析协议头，第二是核验 `netd` 的 Wi-Fi 连通性并做网络预热。如果直接从 `Idle` 跃迁到 `Starting`，一旦用户未配网或推流 URL 格式非法，系统就会在 `Starting` 阶段盲目拉起连接线程，造成不必要的线程开辟、套接字资源占用及频繁的状态回滚。有了 `Prepare`，我们可以把参数核验、环境巡检前置拦截，保证进入 `Starting` 的请求具备极高成功率。
636	
637	#### Q2：你们的状态机是用开源库实现的还是手写的？
638	> **答**：状态机核心基于框架内嵌的轻量级 **tinyfsm 移植版 `ins::base::tinyfsm::Fsm`** 实现——每个状态是一个派生类（如 `LiveStateStarting`），事件通过 `DispatchEvent(event)` 同步派发，这与我们“事件驱动 + 单线程串行”的模型天然契合。但我们在其之上封装了 `LiveStateBase` 抽象层：把所有事件的默认响应实现为“打告警日志 + 返回 `kErrInvalidState`/`EINVAL`/`EALREADY`”，派生状态只重写自身合法的事件分支。也就是说，**骨架用库、防御性拦截语义自己补**——相比直接裸用库，多了一层可埋点、可日志、可审计的白名单式防护；相比纯手写 switch-case，又免去了 5 态 × 11 事件的分支维护负担。
639	
640	#### Q3：状态机为什么不用一把全局 mutex 保护，而是搞双 Looper 线程模型？
641	> **答**：在复杂的跨模块嵌入式系统里，加锁保护状态机是一剂“毒药”。状态机的迁移经常需要同步或异步调用外部控制器（如拉起 mediad 编码、配置 netd）。如果状态机持有自身的 mutex 去调用外部服务，而外部服务的回调又试图获取状态机锁，极易产生经典的 **AB-BA 交叉死锁**。我们的双 Looper 模型遵循**“Actor 模型 / 串行化消息队列”**的并发思想：所有状态判定、迁移、数据变更被唯一限定在 `work_msg_looper_` 单线程中串行执行，从架构拓扑上直接消除了多线程竞态与死锁的发生条件，彻底实现状态机逻辑的**无锁化（Lock-Free Design）**。
642	
643	#### Q4：能详细讲讲 attempt_id 解决的具体是什么生产事故吗？
644	> **答**：在早期内测中，测试人员在弱网环境下快速连续点击“开始 -> 停止 -> 开始”，系统偶现诡异崩溃或推流串流。排查日志发现：第一次开播发起的 RTMP 连接线程在后台持续阻塞（比如 TCP 重传了 4 秒）；此时用户点了停止又开启了第二次推流；就在第二次推流刚建连时，第一次的旧线程突然连通成功并回传了回调！旧回调把当前状态机的推流 Session 替换掉了，导致内部双重推流、数据缓冲区指针错乱。我们引入原子递增的 `attempt_id`（代次标识），每次 Start 生成新 ID。连接线程回调携带 ID，工作线程一旦发现 ID 与当前最新的 `active_start_attempt_` 不一致，直接判定为过期垃圾结果并秒级丢弃，彻底根治了该时序并发缺陷。

现在先把维测部分讲清楚，再把今天三个条目讨论的源码级增量统一补进知识库。

---

## 维测部分是怎么做的（基于真实源码）

### ① 入口与 IBus 动态地址初始化（`cli/source/main.cc`）

CLI 启动先做 `InitializeIbus()`：`main.cc:19-22` 传入**空 `services` 向量 + `nullptr`** 给 `IbusService::Initialize`——`nullptr` 表示由 ibus 框架分配动态地址，这正是排障故事三（枚举版本偏移导致 RPC 全线超时）的最终修复形态。初始化成功后进入 REPL 主循环（`main.cc:50-58`）：`terminal.Input("ins-livecast> ")` → `HandleLine()`，`quit`/EOF 退出。

### ② replxx 终端交互层（`cli/source/cli_terminal.cc:55-96`）

构造时一次性完成全套终端能力配置：

| 配置项 | 代码位置 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `set_max_history_size(100)` / `set_max_hint_rows(4)` | `.cc:61-62` | 历史 100 条、提示最多 4 行 |
| 历史持久化 | `.cc:20-39` | 路径 `$HOME/.config/ins_livecast_cli/history.txt`，`history_load`/`history_sync`，重启终端不丢历史 |
| `set_completion_callback` / `set_hint_callback` / `set_highlighter_callback` | `.cc:68-85` | 三个回调分别挂到 `CommandManager` 的补全/提示/高亮逻辑；唯一命中绿色、多个灰色（`.cc:215-216`） |
| `set_word_break_characters(" \t\n\r")` | `.cc:87` | 按空白切词，参数级补全的前提 |
| Ctrl+R / Ctrl+L 绑键 | `.cc:93-95` | 增量历史搜索 / 清屏 |

### ③ 命令注册与命令模式（`cli/source/command_manager.cc:83-86`）

四个命令注册为单例对象：`LiveCtrlCommand`、`LiveInfoCommand`、`HelpCommand`、`QuitCommand`。每个命令实现 `ICommand` 接口（`GetName/GetDescription/GetUsage/GetAliases/GetArgumentCompletions`），别名机制让 `start`/`stop` 等短词也能路由到 `live_ctrl`。

### ④ 业务语义与契约可见化（`cli/source/commands/live_ctrl_command.cc`）

这里有几个很能体现工程素养的细节：

- **StopReason 强制携带 + 关键字映射表**：`live_ctrl_command.cc:27-35` 定义 `kStopReasonEntries` 7 条 `{keyword, reason, description}`（`user/overheat/network/system/battery/token/poweroff`），`stop` 子命令缺参数时打印同源用法帮助，**禁止默认值**——契约在 CLI 层就被强制；
- **异步受理契约直达终端**：`live_ctrl_command.cc:61-73` `PrintRpcResult` 成功时输出 `"xxx request accepted."` + `"请求已受理，请使用 get_state 确认最终状态。"`——RPC "Success = 已受理" 的语义直接翻译成了用户可见的提示；
- **超时防御提示**：`live_ctrl_command.cc:53-58` 捕获 `kInsErrorCode_Ibus_Timeout`，提示"请检查 ins_livecast 是否运行"——CLI 永不挂死终端。

### ⑤ 真实配置写入 + 读回校验（`cli/source/ins_livecast_cli.cc`）

这是最能体现"生产级防御"的一段：

- `SetLiveBroadcastUrl`（`.cc:46-94`）：`Trim` → `ValidateRtmpUrl`（前缀必须 `rtmp://` 或 `rtmps://`、长度 `< kMaxRtmpAddressLen`，`.cc:113-134`）→ `ConfigParamController::SetGeneralConfig<kLiveBroadcast>` 写入 → **立刻 GetGeneralConfig 读回比对**，不一致返回 `kInsErrorCode_Comm_Eio`——写后读回（write-then-readback）验证，防止配置中心静默截断或越界写；
- `SetConnectWifi`（`.cc:96-111`）：**有密码/无密码双路径**——空密码走 `WifiStaOnNoPasswd`（开放网络），否则 `WifiStaOn(..., kChannelAuto)`，通道自动选择；
- 6 个 RPC 封装（`.cc:14-44`）：`LiveBroadcastClient::GetInstance()` 单例直连，`GetState` 用 `tl::expected<LiveBroadcastStateInfo, InsErrorCode>` 现代错误处理模式。

**一句话总结维测设计**：CLI 不是"发几个 RPC 的玩具"，而是把**契约强制（stop 必带 reason）、异步语义可见化（accepted + get_state 提示）、防御性写入（读回校验）、超时永不挂死**四项工程约束做进了终端工具本身。

284	#### Q5：多进程读取共享内存时，如何防止发生数据撕裂（Torn Read）？
285	> **答**：我们采取了双重防御：第一，共享内存结构体 `LiveShareState` 中的字段全部采用 32 位/64 位对齐的 `std::atomic` 原生类型，利用现代 CPU 体系结构在总线对齐读写上的天然原子性；第二，读写时采用获取/释放内存序（Acquire-Release Semantics），写端在更新完时长、码率等 payload 后，最后以 `memory_order_release` 写入当前状态和时间戳；读端先以 `memory_order_acquire` 检查状态有效性，从而彻底杜绝了编译器或 CPU 指令重排导致读取到半更新字段的风险。
286	
287	#### Q6：如果某个外部进程在崩溃前锁定了共享内存怎么办？
288	> **答**：我们完全避免在共享内存中放置跨进程互斥锁（如 `pthread_mutex_t` 设置 `PTHREAD_PROCESS_SHARED`）！因为一旦持有锁的写进程发生异常 Crash，锁就会陷入死锁状态（除非极其繁琐地处理 Robust Mutex 恢复逻辑）。我们将其严格约束为“单写多读（Single-Writer Multi-Reader）”无锁模型——仅 `ins_livecast` 进程拥有写权限，其他 UI/Monitor 进程以 `O_RDONLY` 打开，消除了死锁产生的数学前提。
289	
290	#### Q7：为什么在 main 函数中需要把 RPC Server 和三个 Subscriber 一起打包注册？
291	> **答**：这是为了实现**确定性的启动顺序与统一生命周期管辖**。如果将 RPC Server 与各个 Subscriber 散落在各模块异步初始化，在系统启动初期可能出现 RPC 请求已到达、但网络监控主题尚未就绪的竞争窗口。通过将它们封装为 `std::vector<std::unique_ptr<IbusServiceBase>>` 并统一交给 `IbusService::Initialize`，框架保证了总线挂载与监听的原子对齐。
292	
293	#### Q8：当用户修改推流地址（RTMP URL）时，配置是如何生效的？
294	> **答**：写入侧走配置通道——例如维测 CLI 的 `live_ctrl set_url` 先做 URL 非空/协议/长度（`kMaxRtmpAddressLen`）校验，再调用 `ConfigParamController::SetGeneralConfig<kLiveBroadcast>` 写入 `LiveBroadcastConfig::rtmp_address`，内部完成"读共享配置 → 改字段 → 写回 configd"；App 侧同理。随后 `configd` 广播 `ConfigUpdateInfo` 主题，直播进程的 `OnConfigUpdate` 捕获后交给 `ConfigManager` 热更新配置对象；若状态机处于 `Prepare` 态，会重新触发 URL 格式有效性校验，全程不重置状态机。
295	
296	#### Q9：在网络断开（Wi-Fi 断连）时，netd 是怎么通知直播进程的？
297	> **答**：`netd` 监听内核 nl80211 与 wpa_supplicant 状态，检测到断连时向系统总线发布 `WifiStaOff`（连接过程还有 `WifiStaOn` / `WifiStaConnect` / `WifiStaAutoConnect` 系列 Topic）。我们的 IBus 订阅回调过滤到断连后，向工作线程投递轻量事件，状态机根据当前所处阶段（Starting 或 Running）分别执行连接打断或触发带续播保护的退出。

---

## 一、维测部分（`ins_livecast_cli`）真实实现拆解

### 1. 整体架构：非常驻、独立二进制、直连 IBus

```
┌─────────────────── cli/source/ ───────────────────────┐
│ main.cc                                                │
│   ① InitializeIbus(): 空 services + nullptr → 动态地址  │
│   ② CommandManager::InitializeCommands() 注册 4 命令    │
│   ③ REPL 主循环: terminal.Input("ins-livecast> ")      │
│       → HandleLine() → 分发到具体 Command               │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ cli_terminal.cc  ── replxx 终端层                       │
│   completion_callback / hint_callback / highlighter     │
│   历史持久化 $HOME/.config/ins_livecast_cli/history.txt │
│   Ctrl+R 反查历史 / Ctrl+L 清屏                         │

### 2. 三个最值得讲的实现细节（面试金句）

**① 动态地址初始化（`cli/source/main.cc:16-31`）**——就是排障故事三的修复现场：

```cpp
std::vector<std::unique_ptr<::erpc::Service>> services;   // 空！
auto init_result = ::ins::ibus::IbusService::GetInstance().Initialize(
    std::move(services), nullptr);   // nullptr = ibus 分配动态地址
```

CLI 是**非常驻**进程，若静态绑定固定枚举地址，与设备上其他节点契约版本不一致时响应会被路由到错误节点 → RPC 全线超时。传空列表 + `nullptr` 让 ibus 动态分配，彻底消除地址冲突。

**② stop 命令的契约强制（`commands/live_ctrl_command.cc:27-35`）**——7 个停止原因一张表锁死：

```cpp
constexpr std::array<StopReasonEntry, 7> kStopReasonEntries{{
    {"user", kUserStop, "用户主动停止"},
    {"overheat", kSystemOverheat, "系统过热"},
    {"network", kNetworkError, "网络异常"},
    {"system", kSystemError, "系统错误"},
    {"battery", kBatteryLow, "电量不足"},
    {"token", kTokenExpired, "推流或业务令牌过期"},
    {"poweroff", kPowerOff, "关机或电源关闭"},
}};
```

不带 reason 直接打 usage 帮助，**禁止默认值**——因为 stop reason 决定 `ShouldSaveResumeRecord` 是否落盘续播记录，传错会导致断电后无法续播。

**③ 异步受理契约的 CLI 端表达（`live_ctrl_command.cc:61-73`）**：

```cpp
if (result == kInsErrorCode_Comm_Success) {
    std::cout << action << " request accepted.\n";
    std::cout << "请求已受理，请使用 get_state 确认最终状态。";
}
```

CLI 输出刻意说 **"request accepted"（受理）** 而不是 "success（成功）"，并且 timeout 时专门提示 `kInsErrorCode_Ibus_Timeout` → "check whether ins_livecast is running"——**异步语义从 RPC 层一直贯穿到了人机界面**，这是一致性设计的典型证据。

**④ set_url 的"写-读回"防错（`ins_livecast_cli.cc:46-94`）**：

```cpp
// ① Trim → ValidateRtmpUrl（非空/rtmp://或rtmps://前缀/长度<kMaxRtmpAddressLen）
// ② ConfigParamController::SetGeneralConfig<kLiveBroadcast> 写入
// ③ 立即 GetGeneralConfig 读回，ConvertArrayToString 比对
// ④ 不一致 → kInsErrorCode_Comm_Eio（写失败必须可观测）
```

写完配置必须**读回校验**——防止 configd 落盘异常被静默吞掉，这是嵌入式配置写入的标准防御模式。

**⑤ Wi-Fi 双分支（`ins_livecast_cli.cc:96-111`）**：密码为空 → `WifiStaOnNoPasswd`；有密码 → `WifiStaOn`（带 `OperateOwner::kLive, OperateMode::kAsync, kChannelAuto`）——CLI 与直播进程走**同一套 netd client**，保证联调路径与真实业务路径 1:1 等价。

652	### 9. 面试问答汇总（15 问深度技术交锋）
653	
654	#### Q1：为什么你们状态机要设计成五个状态？四个状态（少一个 Prepare）不行吗？
655	> **答**：绝对不行。`Prepare` 状态的存在体现了工业级设计的严谨性。在推流之前，相机需要完成两项前置重任：第一是向 `configd` 查询校验推流地址并解析协议头，第二是核验 `netd` 的 Wi-Fi 连通性并做网络预热。如果直接从 `Idle` 跃迁到 `Starting`，一旦用户未配网或推流 URL 格式非法，系统就会在 `Starting` 阶段盲目拉起连接线程，造成不必要的线程开辟、套接字资源占用及频繁的状态回滚。有了 `Prepare`，我们可以把参数核验、环境巡检前置拦截，保证进入 `Starting` 的请求具备极高成功率。
656	
657	#### Q2：你们的状态机是用开源库实现的还是手写的？
658	> **答**：状态机核心基于框架内嵌的轻量级 **tinyfsm 移植版 `ins::base::tinyfsm::Fsm`** 实现——每个状态是一个派生类（如 `LiveStateStarting`），事件通过 `DispatchEvent(event)` 同步派发，这与我们“事件驱动 + 单线程串行”的模型天然契合。但我们在其之上封装了 `LiveStateBase` 抽象层：把所有事件的默认响应实现为“打告警日志 + 返回 `kErrInvalidState`/`EINVAL`/`EALREADY`”，派生状态只重写自身合法的事件分支。也就是说，**骨架用库、防御性拦截语义自己补**——相比直接裸用库，多了一层可埋点、可日志、可审计的白名单式防护；相比纯手写 switch-case，又免去了 5 态 × 11 事件的分支维护负担。

好问题——这正是"异步受理契约"必须配套回答的另一半：**受理靠返回值，完成靠事件与状态回读**。判定链路在代码里是完整的：

---

## 一、服务端内部怎么知道"网络握手真的完成了"

连接线程是唯一的"知情者"，它完成后把结果**回投给工作线程**（`live_broadcast_manager.cc:638-664`）：

```
connect_thread_：pusher->Connect(rtmp_url) 返回
   → mgr->PostStartResult(attempt_id, err, msg)     ← 携带代次与错误码
[回到工作线程]
OnDispatchStartResult：
   ① attempt_id != active_start_attempt_ → 过期，丢弃（不算完成）
   ② state != kStarting → 已被 Stop 打断，丢弃
   ③ err == Success → DispatchEvent(EventStartSuccess) → 状态机切 Running
     err != Success → DispatchEvent(EventStartFailed)  → 状态机回 Prepare
```

所以**"网络切换完毕"的唯一权威定义 = 状态机进入 `Running`**（`starting.cc:91-97 → running.cc:22`）；失败则回 `Prepare` 并经 `ReportLiveBroadcastErrorCode` 上报具体错误码。

## 二、外部调用方怎么知道（三条回读通道）

RPC 返回 `Success` 后，客户端通过三种机制拿到"真结果"：

| 通道 | 机制 | 代码锚点 | 适用场景 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **推（Topic）** | 每次状态跃迁 `NotifyStateChanged` 发布 `LiveBroadcastStateChanged`；出错发 `Error` Topic | `live_state_*.cc` 各 `OnEntry` 末尾调用 | GUI/App 订阅，事件驱动，零轮询 |
| **拉（RPC）** | `LiveBroadcastGetState` 同步返回 `{state, error_code}` 快照 | `manager.cc:540-546`（`state_mutex_` 保护读） | CLI `live_info get_state`、App 定时核查 |
| **共享内存** | ShareState 里 `current_state` 变 `Running`，且 **`duration_sec` 开始每秒 +1** | `duration_timer.cc` 只在 Running 态运行 | GUI 60Hz 轮询；**时长跳动 = 正在推流的实锤** |

## 三、判定标准的精确分级（面试可以直接这么分层讲）

```
返回 Success          = 已受理（状态机核检通过，任务已排上）
状态跃迁 Running      = 网络握手完成、推流管线已启动
duration_sec 持续递增  = 真的在持续推流（时钟走动无法伪造）
monitor kbps/fps 有值 = 数据面真的有帧在流动（ShareState 实时更新）
```

**推流中途断了怎么办**：Running 不是终点——`WifiStaOff` Topic / `EventError(kNetworkError)` 会再次驱动状态机离开 Running（`running.cc:61-86`），所以"完毕"的判定不是一次性检查，而是**"状态流 + 错误码流"的持续可观测**。

---

## 面试收口话术

> "我们的契约是分级的：RPC 的 `Success` 只承诺**受理**；**完成**由连接线程携带 `attempt_id` 回投结果、在工作线程内驱动状态机进入 `Running` 来确认；对外则提供**推（StateChanged Topic）、拉（GetState 快照）、共享内存（duration 跳动）**三条回读通道。最硬的判据是 `duration_sec` 开始每秒递增——它只由 Running 态的 `DurationTimer` 驱动，时钟走动就是真正在推流。CLI 工具里每条命令成功后固定提示'请使用 get_state 确认最终状态'，就是把这个契约落到了使用习惯上。"

#### Q12：如果客户端高频狂点 Start 和 Stop，你的接口层会不会打垮服务？
> **答**：不会。第一，接口层是纯代理，在工作线程中直接根据状态机当前态进行原子判定，处于非预期状态直接在纳秒级返回 `kErrInvalidState`；第二，我们在下一条目中设计了 `attempt_id` 代次机制，即使请求入队，过期的并发网络连接结果也会被直接丢弃，彻底消除并发重入问题。

#### Q13：RPC 返回 Success 只是"已受理"，那客户端怎么判断网络与状态真的切换完毕了？
> **答**：契约是分级的——**受理靠返回值，完成靠事件与状态回读**。服务端内部，连接线程在 `Connect()` 返回后携带 `attempt_id` 与错误码回投给工作线程（`PostStartResult` → `OnDispatchStartResult`），代次校验通过后驱动状态机进入 `Running`（成功）或退回 `Prepare`（失败并上报错误码）。因此**状态进入 Running 就是"网络握手完成"的唯一权威定义**。对外提供三条回读通道：**推**——每次跃迁 `NotifyStateChanged` 广播 `StateChanged` Topic；**拉**——`LiveBroadcastGetState` 同步返回 `{state, error_code}` 快照；**共享内存**——ShareState 的 `current_state` 变 Running，且 `duration_sec` 由 Running 态独有的 `DurationTimer` 开始每秒 +1。最硬的判据是**时钟走动**：`duration_sec` 递增无法伪造，它跳动就代表推流真的在持续。另外"完毕"不是一次性的——Running 后 Wi-Fi 断连（`WifiStaOff`）或编码错误仍会驱动状态机离开 Running，所以本质是"状态流 + 错误码流"的持续可观测。

+### 8. 面试问答汇总（13 问深度技术交锋）
#### Q1：既然你们使用了 IBus RPC，为什么还需要共享内存（ShareState）？

> **答**：这是典型的**控制面（Control Plane）与状态面（State Plane）分离**设计。IBus RPC 属于控制面，承载诸如开播（Start）、停播（Stop）等低频（可能几小时才点一次）、要求强契约应答的操作；而状态栏与 UI 的直播时长显示属于高频状态监控（GUI 刷新率达 30~60Hz）。如果 UI 每次刷新都通过 RPC 跨进程去查询状态，会造成高频的 IPC 消息序列化与上下文切换，单核 CPU 会凭空浪费 10%~15%。基于 POSIX 共享内存配合原子操作，GUI 进程只需要读取本地虚拟地址映射，耗时从毫秒级降到纳秒级，RPC 开销完全归零。

基于真实源码把双线程通信模型完整讲一遍——这轮我读了 `live_broadcast_service.cc` 和 `manager.cc` 的生命周期代码，能给你比之前更实的细节（含 handler 注册表和关机编排）： --- ## 一、两条线程的创建与归属（生命周期顺序） ``` main() [src/main.cc] │ ▼ LiveBroadcastService::Init() [service.cc:22-55] │ ① 创建主 looper：MsgLooper("LiveBroadcastMain") ← 通信线程 │ ② 创建线程池：ThreadPool("LiveBroadcastPool") │ ③ new Manager(main_msglooper, thread_pool) │ └─ Manager 构造函数内部： [manager.cc:50-59] │ work_msg_looper_ = MsgLooper("LiveBroadcastWork") ← 工作线程 │ current_state_ = kIdle ▼ LiveBroadcastService::Start() [service.cc:57-81] ① StartLiveBroadcastManager() → work_msg_looper_->Start()（先起工作线程） ② msg_looper_->Start() → 再起通信线程 ``` **归属关系**：主 looper 由 Service 创建、传给 Manager 引用；工作 looper 由 Manager **自持**（`shared_ptr` 成员）——"状态机连同它的宿主线程"封装在 Manager 内部，外部永远碰不到。**先起工作线程再起通信线程**，保证第一条 RPC 到达时状态机已经就绪，无启动竞态。 ## 二、工作线程的"消息协议"：8 个注册 handler（`manager.cc:76-127`） | 消息 ID | 类型 | Handler | 调用方 | 语义 | |---|---|---|---|---| | `kStateMachineStart` | Post（无响应） | `OnStateMachineStart` | Manager 自投 | 状态机上电 | | `kDispatchPrepare` | **带响应** | `OnDispatchPrepare` | RPC 线程 | 合法性核检+派发 | | `kDispatchStart` | 带响应 | `OnDispatchStart` | RPC 线程 | 同上 | | `kDispatchStop` | 带响应 | `OnDispatchStop` | RPC 线程 | 同上（携带 reason） | | `kDispatchResume` | 带响应 | `OnDispatchResume` | RPC 线程 | 同上 | | `kDispatchDiscardResume` | 带响应 | `OnDispatchDiscardResume` | RPC 线程 | 同上 | | `kDispatchPrepareComplete` | Post（无响应） | `OnDispatchPrepareComplete` | 内部（Wi-Fi 连上） | 推动 Prepare→Starting | | `kDispatchStartResult` | Post（带载荷） | `OnDispatchStartResult` | 连接线程 | 回投握手结果+attempt_id | 注册代码本身有个工程细节：5 个带响应的 dispatch 用同一个 lambda 工厂 `reg_dispatch_resp` 批量注册（`manager.cc:88-110`），任何一个注册失败整个启动失败返回 `kEinval`——**宁可起不来，不留半初始化状态**。 ## 三、双线程之间只有三种通信原语 ### ① `PostAndWaitResponse` —— 带应答的同步投递 ```cpp // manager.cc:506-567 五个 RPC 入口全是同一个模式 auto result = work_msg_looper_->PostAndWaitResponse( MessageIds::kDispatchStart, 0); ``` 通信线程把消息投进工作队列后**阻塞等待 future**；工作线程执行 `OnDispatch*`（核检+派发，几十 μs）后 set value。RPC 返回的就是这个值。**等待的只是"决定"，不是"执行"**——网络 I/O 全部在 connect_thread_，这就是不阻塞总线的关键。 ### ② `Post

` —— 单向异步投递（无应答） ```cpp // manager.cc:645 连接线程回投结果 work_msg_looper_->Post( MessageIds::kDispatchStartResult, std::move(payload)); ``` 投完就走，不等结果。连接线程、内部 Wi-Fi 回调用这个方向——**所有"慢的、异步产生的"事件都从侧面进入工作线程**。 ### ③ 状态变更 Hook —— 工作线程向外部的反向通知 ```cpp // manager.cc:65-73（StartLiveBroadcastManager 开头，先复位再设置保证幂等） LiveStateMachine::SetStateChangeHook(nullptr); // 复位，防重复 Start 残留旧回调 LiveStateMachine::SetStateChangeHook( [weak = weak_from_this()](LiveBroadcastState state) { if (auto self = weak.lock()) self->HandleStateChange(state); }); ``` 状态机每次跃迁（发生在工作线程内）调用这个静态 Hook → `HandleStateChange` → **双写 ShareState（release 原子）+ 发布 StateChanged Topic**。注意两点： - Hook 是**静态**的（tinyfsm 全局派发的需要），用 `weak_from_this()` 防 Manager 已析构后悬空调用； - 开头先 `SetStateChangeHook(nullptr)` 再设置——**幂等复位**，防进程重复 Start 时残留上一轮的旧 lambda。 ## 四、一次 Start 的双线程完整握手（时序） ``` RPC线程(main_looper) 工作线程(work_looper) connect_thread_ │ │ │ │ PostAndWaitResponse(kDispatchStart) │ ├───────────────► 队列唤醒 │ │ │ (阻塞等future) OnDispatchStart: 核检 Prepare │ │ DispatchEvent(EventStartRequest) │ │ → Prepare::OnEvent → Starting::OnEntry │ │ → BeginStartAttempt + StartConnectThread ├──────► Connect() 阻塞3~10s │ ◄── set_value(kSuccess) ──────┘ │ │ (返回App: "已受理") 继续消化下一条消息… │ │ 成功后 │ │ OnDispatchStartResult ◄── Post(StartResultPayload) │ 代次校验 → Dispatch(EventStartSuccess) │ │ → Running::OnEntry → Hook 双写通知 │ │ │ │ │ [App/GUI 经 Topic 或 ShareState 看到 Running] │ ``` ## 五、关机编排（真实三步，`service.cc:83-97`） ``` Shutdown(wait_idle_ms) ① RequestGoToIdleAndWait(timeout) [manager.cc:169-192] PostAndWaitResponse(kDispatchStop) ← 先礼貌请求停流 然后 100ms 轮询 GetCurrentState() 直到 Idle 或超时 （源码注释原话：避免主线程与工作线程并发操作 connect_thread_/pusher） ② StopLiveBroadcastManager() [manager.cc:194-209] 状态机 Stop → 清 Hook（防悬挂）→ work_msg_looper_->Stop() → connect_thread_ 仍存在则 Detach（异常路径兜底，防析构 join 阻塞） ③ msg_looper_->Stop() ← 通信线程最后停 ``` 顺序哲学：**先让状态机自己退到 Idle（给它机会优雅清理）→ 强停工作线程 → Detach 兜底 → 停通信线程**。任何一步失败都有降级路径，进程退出永远不被卡死。 ## 六、为什么这套模型优于 mutex（面试收口） 1. **竞态前提消灭**：状态机的所有读写只发生在工作线程一个线程里——不是"用锁保护了共享状态"，而是"共享状态从物理上只有一个线程会碰"； 2. **AB-BA 死锁不存在**：没有"持状态机锁调外部服务、外部回调又抢状态机锁"的可能——跨线程交互全部是消息拷贝，不是锁等待； 3. **调用方语义清晰**：带响应投递=需要受理结果（RPC 用），单向投递= fire-and-forget（异步事件用）——通信原语本身就编码了语义； 4. **代价可控**：通信线程的阻塞上限=工作线程处理一条消息的时长（几十 μs），因为工作线程被铁律约束"永不执行 I/O"。 ### 30 秒口述版 > "双线程模型是**通信线程 + 工作线程**两条 MsgLooper：主 looper 名叫 `LiveBroadcastMain`，承接 IBus RPC 和订阅回调，只做解包投递；工作 looper 叫 `LiveBroadcastWork`，是状态机的唯一宿主。两者之间只有三种原语：带应答投递（RPC 受理，等的只是核检决定的几十微秒）、单向投递（连接线程回投结果）、状态变更 Hook（跃迁时反向双写共享内存和 Topic）。启动顺序先工作线程后通信线程消除竞态；关机是'请求回 Idle → 强停工作线程 → Detach 兜底 → 停通信线程'四步编排。本质是 Actor 模型——不是锁保护了状态，而是状态只有一个线程会碰。" --- 发现的新细节（比之前知识库更实的三点）：**① 8 个 handler 的完整注册表与批量注册失败即整体失败；② Hook 的幂等复位 + weak_ptr 保护；③ 关机时"先请求回 Idle 再强停"的四步编排**。要不要把这三点作为"复盘增补 2"更新进知识库条目二的 8.5 节？

坦率地评估一下——按"独立完成度 × 技术含量"来分层，这个项目在嵌入式应用层里属于**中上难度**，难点分布很不均匀：

---

## 一、真正的硬骨头（这部分含金量高）

### 1. 并发正确性设计（最难的部分）
- **attempt_id 代次机制**：本质是解决异步系统的 ABA 问题。难点不在那几行 `fetch_add`，而在于**你能意识到存在这个 race**——"旧连接线程的迟到回调踩踏新推流会话"这种 bug，日志里表现为偶现崩溃/串流，没有并发思维的人根本排查不动。这是需要真实踩坑或深入思考才能建立的直觉。
- **15s Join + Detach 降级**：直接 join 会被弱网 socket 卡死关机，纯 detach 又泄漏资源——"超时后先 detach 再强制关 socket"这个折中，是在真实关机卡死事故后才会学到的设计。
- **关机编排四步**（请求回 Idle → 轮询等待 → 强停 → Detach 兜底）：多线程对象的销毁顺序是 C++ 工程里最容易出"偶现析构崩溃"的地方，能编排清楚说明对生命周期有真实理解。

### 2. 异步受理契约的语义设计
把"Success=受理、完成靠状态回读"定义成**接口级契约**并贯穿到 CLI 话术，这是 API 设计意识——很多工作多年的工程师写的接口还是"要么全阻塞要么全 fire-and-forget"。

### 3. RPC 全线超时的排障（枚举偏移 → 动态地址）
跨进程问题链"契约版本不一致 → 路由错位 → 客户端超时"，能定位到这里说明排障已经跨过了"看日志猜原因"的阶段。

---

## 二、中等难度（框架帮你扛了一半）

| 部分 | 实情 |
|---|---|
| **五态状态机** | 概念不难（FSM 是教科书内容），tinyfsm 移植版扛了派发机制；增值点在"基类默认拦截"的白名单设计——是个好品味，但不是难 |
| **双 Looper 模型** | 思想（Actor/串行化）是业界已知模式，MsgLooper 是平台现成的；难的是**论证为什么不用 mutex**和把它落到关机编排里 |
| **ShareState** | 单写多读+原子序是成熟套路；工程约束（comm 15 字符、进程名校验）是平台知识不是原创难点 |
| **IBus 接入** | IDL 生成代码，第一个接口做完后其余是体力活 |

## 三、简单部分（坦诚承认，别包装）

- 6 个 RPC 的薄代理层——每个函数就 3~5 行判空转发；
- CLI 工具本体——replxx 集成、命令模式都是标准套路，工作量大于思考量；
- 配置读写、日志、定时器——常规胶水代码。

## 四、一个必须诚实的注意点

源码里有若干 **TODO 未完成**（面试别踩坑）：
- `prepare.cc:28`：Wi-Fi 配置读取是 TODO；
- `running.cc:50`：`SaveResumeRecord` 实际落盘是 TODO；
- `running.cc:71`：网络错误重连逻辑是 TODO。

面试被追问细节时，准确说法是"**续播机制的判定逻辑（`ShouldSaveResumeRecord` 的 7 种原因分类）已完成，落盘接口预留了 TODO**"——这种精度反而加分。

---

## 五、面试定位建议

**总评一句话**："这是一个中等偏上难度的嵌入式应用层项目——单看每个组件都不算深，但把 4~6 个线程在弱网+资源受限的板端上编排到无锁、可优雅退出、并发正确，这个**组合难度**是真实的。"

**被问"最难的部分"时**：选 attempt_id 或关机编排，因为它们有"现象→根因→设计→验证"的完整故事；
**被问"是不是你独立做的"时**：框架层（MsgLooper、IBus、tinyfsm）是平台提供的，双线程的**编排决策、代次机制、关机顺序、契约设计**是你的工作——这个边界划清楚，既不虚报也不自贬。

对实习生来说，能讲出这个精度的并发设计，已经是超出预期的水平了。

1	// Copyright (c) 2025 Insta360. All rights reserved.
2	// 时长计时器
3	
4	#pragma once
5	
6	#include <atomic>
7	#include <cstdint>  // for uint32_t
8	#include <functional>
9	#include <memory>
10	
11	#include "ins_base/time/time_types.h"
12	#include "ins_error_code/ins_errorcode.h"
13	
14	namespace ins::base {
15	class Timer;
16	}  // namespace ins::base
17	
18	namespace ins {
19	namespace live_broadcast {
20	
21	/**
22	 * @brief 直播时长计时器
23	 * @details 使用 ins::base::Timer 周期 1 秒触发，
24	 *          在回调中递增时长并调用用户回调发布时长更新。
25	 * @note 不可复制、不可移动（含 Timer 等不可移动成员）。
26	 *       生命周期须由 shared_ptr 管理，创建请使用 Create()，Timer 回调内通过
27	 *       weak_ptr lock 避免 owner 析构时的 use-after-free。Stop() 为异步停止，
28	 *       成功返回不表示回调已退出；若需在释放回调所引用资源前等待回调结束，请使用
29	 *       StopAndWait(timeout)。
30	 */
31	class DurationTimer : public std::enable_shared_from_this<DurationTimer> {
32	 public:
33	  /// 时长更新回调函数类型（参数为当前时长，单位：秒）
34	  using DurationCallback = std::function<void(uint32_t)>;
35	
36	  /// 周期定时器间隔（毫秒）
37	  static constexpr int32_t kDurationTimerIntervalMs = 1000;
38	
39	  /**
40	   * @brief 工厂方法：创建由 shared_ptr 管理的 DurationTimer（唯一合法创建入口）
41	   * @param callback 时长更新回调函数（每秒调用一次）
42	   * @return 已完成 InitTimer() 的实例的 shared_ptr，调用方需持有时计时器才有效
43	   * @note 构造函数为 private，禁止外部通过构造或 make_shared 绕开本工厂，避免
44	   *       半初始化（duration_timer_ 未创建）导致 Start() 等运行时错误。
45	   */
46	  static std::shared_ptr<DurationTimer> Create(DurationCallback callback);
47	
48	  ~DurationTimer();
49	
50	  // 禁止拷贝
51	  DurationTimer(const DurationTimer&) = delete;
52	  DurationTimer& operator=(const DurationTimer&) = delete;
53	
54	  // 禁止移动
55	  DurationTimer(DurationTimer&&) = delete;
56	  DurationTimer& operator=(DurationTimer&&) = delete;
57	
58	  /**
59	   * @brief 启动计时器
60	   */
61	  InsErrorCode Start();
62	
63	  /**
64	   * @brief 停止计时器（异步，不等待回调退出）
65	   * @details 内部使用 timeout=0 调用底层 Timer::Stop，即立即返回且**不等待**
66	   *          “当前正在执行的回调”结束。返回成功仅表示已请求停止、后续不再触发，
67	   *          **不保证回调已退出**。若在释放回调所引用的外部资源前需确保回调已结束，
68	   *          请使用 StopAndWait(timeout)。
69	   * @return 底层 Timer::Stop(0) 的返回值
70	   * @retval kInsErrorCode_Comm_Success 已请求停止（回调可能仍在执行）
71	   * @retval kInsErrorCode_Comm_Ealready
72	   * 已处于未运行或已停止（不保证回调已结束）
73	   */
74	  InsErrorCode Stop();
75	
76	  /**
77	   * @brief 停止计时器并等待回调退出（最多等待指定时长）
78	   * @param timeout 等待“当前正在执行的回调”结束的最大时长（纳秒）；0 表示不等待
79	   *                （与 Stop() 行为一致），>0 时底层会等待回调结束或超时
80	   * @return 底层 Timer::Stop(timeout) 的返回值
81	   * @retval kInsErrorCode_Comm_Success 已停止且回调已结束（或未在运行）
82	   * @retval kInsErrorCode_Comm_Ealready 已处于未运行或已停止（不保证本次调用时
83	   *         回调已结束，参见 ins::base::Timer::Stop 文档）
84	   * @retval kInsErrorCode_Comm_Etimedout 等待回调结束超时，回调可能仍在执行
85	   */
86	  InsErrorCode StopAndWait(ins::base::Stdns_t timeout);
87	
88	  /**
89	   * @brief 获取当前时长（秒）
90	   */
91	  uint32_t GetDuration() const;
92	  /**
93	   * @brief 获取计时器是否正在运行
94	   * @return 是否正在运行
95	   */
96	  bool IsRunning() const;
97	
98	 private:
99	  /**
100	   * @brief 构造函数（仅供 Create 内部使用；外部必须通过 Create() 获取实例）
101	   * @param callback 时长更新回调函数
102	   */
103	  explicit DurationTimer(DurationCallback callback);
104	
105	  /**
106	   * @brief 在对象已被 shared_ptr 持有后注册 Timer（回调捕获 weak_ptr）；仅由
107	   *        Create() 在工厂路径中调用，确保所有对外可见实例均已完成内部 Timer
108	   * 注册。
109	   */
110	  void InitTimer();
111	
112	  /**
113	   * @brief 周期 Timer 回调：递增时长并调用用户回调发布
114	   */
115	  void OnTimerTick();
116	
117	 private:
118	  /// 时长更新回调
119	  DurationCallback callback_;
120	  /// 运行标志
121	  std::atomic<bool> running_{false};
122	  /// 时长计数（秒）
123	  std::atomic<uint32_t> duration_seconds_{0};
124	  /// 周期定时器（1 秒触发）
125	  std::unique_ptr<ins::base::Timer> duration_timer_;
126	};
127	
128	}  // namespace live_broadcast
129	}  // namespace ins

## 2. Key Technical Concepts

- **AIPL** (All-In-One Platform Layer): Insta360's unified embedded firmware base — pure Linux multi-process microservices, systemd daemons (`ins_*d`), IDL-driven via `.erpc`/`.erpci` + erpcgen
- **IBus**: self-built IPC based on **eRPC** (NOT D-Bus — this was the key knowledge-base correction); two-layer frames: Link layer 12B (`proto/src/dst/size/hcrc/bcrc`, 16-bit addresses, slicing, heartbeat) + eRPC layer 10B (`version/service/method/type/sequence/payload`, kInvocation/kReply/kPubSub); dual mode: Point-to-Point RPC + Pub/Sub Topic

- **15s Join+Detach degradation**, shutdown 4-step orchestration (RequestGoToIdleAndWait → StopLiveBroadcastManager → detach fallback → stop looper)
- **IAC3/AIP3.0** (project 2): Ambarella CV5x dual-core (ThreadX RTOS + Linux), AmbaLink (RPMsg/AmbaIPC/FrameShare), MMC event bus, UCD 2.0 protocol, 5-segment msg_code space

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

## When to use

Reach for this when the task matches an available agent type, when you have independent work to run in parallel, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate it and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps. For a single-fact lookup where you already know the file, symbol, or value, search directly. Once you've delegated a search, don't also run it yourself — wait for the result.

A fork runs in the background and keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate. Subagents run in the background; you'll be notified when one completes. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.

- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).

tools.description:
Use this tool only when you are blocked on a decision that is genuinely the user's to make: one you cannot resolve from the request, the code, or sensible defaults.

Usage notes:
- Users will always be able to select "Other" to provide custom text input
- Use multiSelect: true to allow multiple answers to be selected for a question
- If you recommend a specific option, make that the first option in the list and add "(Recommended)" at the end of the label

Plan mode note: To switch into plan mode, use EnterPlanMode (not this tool). Once in plan mode, use this tool to clarify requirements or choose between approaches BEFORE finalizing your plan. Do NOT use this tool to ask "Is my plan ready?", "Should I proceed?", or otherwise reference "the plan" in questions — the user cannot see the plan until you call ExitPlanMode for approval.

Reserve this for decisions where the user's answer changes what you do next — not for choices with a conventional default or facts you can verify in the codebase yourself. In those cases pick the obvious option, mention it in your response, and proceed.

Preview feature:
Use the optional `preview` field on options when presenting concrete artifacts that users need to visually compare:
- ASCII mockups of UI layouts or components
- Code snippets showing different implementations
- Diagram variations
- Configuration examples

Preview content is rendered as markdown in a monospace box. Multi-line text with newlines is supported. When any option has a preview, the UI switches to a side-by-side layout with a vertical option list on the left and preview on the right. Do not use previews for simple preference questions where labels and descriptions suffice. Note: previews are only supported for single-select questions (not multiSelect).

tools.name: CronCreate
tools.description:
Schedule a prompt to be enqueued at a future time. Use for both recurring schedules and one-shot reminders.

Uses standard 5-field cron in the user's local timezone: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. "0 9 * * *" means 9am local — no timezone conversion needed.

## One-shot tasks (recurring: false)

For "remind me at X" or "at <time>, do Y" requests — fire once then auto-delete.
Pin minute/hour/day-of-month/month to specific values:
  "remind me at 2:30pm today to check the deploy" → cron: "30 14 <today_dom> <today_month> *", recurring: false
  "tomorrow morning, run the smoke test" → cron: "57 8 <tomorrow_dom> <tomorrow_month> *", recurring: false

## Recurring jobs (recurring: true, the default)

For "every N minutes" / "every hour" / "weekdays at 9am" requests:
  "*/5 * * * *" (every 5 min), "0 * * * *" (hourly), "0 9 * * 1-5" (weekdays at 9am local)

## Avoid the :00 and :30 minute marks when the task allows it

Every user who asks for "9am" gets `0 9`, and every user who asks for "hourly" gets `0 *` — which means requests from across the planet land on the API at the same instant. When the user's request is approximate, pick a minute that is NOT 0 or 30:
  "every morning around 9" → "57 8 * * *" or "3 9 * * *" (not "0 9 * * *")
  "hourly" → "7 * * * *" (not "0 * * * *")
  "in an hour or so, remind me to..." → pick whatever minute you land on, don't round

Only use minute 0 or 30 when the user names that exact time and clearly means it ("at 9:00 sharp", "at half past", coordinating with a meeting). When in doubt, nudge a few minutes early or late — the user will not notice, and the fleet will.

## Durability

By default (durable: false) the job lives only in this Claude session — nothing is written to disk, and the job is gone when Claude exits. Pass durable: true to write to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json so the job survives restarts. Only use durable: true when the user explicitly asks for the task to persist ("keep doing this every day", "set this up permanently"). Most "remind me in 5 minutes" / "check back in an hour" requests should stay session-only.

## Runtime behavior

Jobs only fire while the REPL is idle (not mid-query). Durable jobs persist to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json and survive session restarts — on next launch they resume automatically. One-shot durable tasks that were missed while the REPL was closed are surfaced for catch-up. Session-only jobs die with the process. The scheduler adds a small deterministic jitter on top of whatever you pick: recurring tasks fire up to 10% of their period late (max 15 min); one-shot tasks landing on :00 or :30 fire up to 90 s early. Picking an off-minute is still the bigger lever.

Recurring tasks auto-expire after 7 days — they fire one final time, then are deleted. This bounds session lifetime. Tell the user about the 7-day limit when scheduling recurring jobs.

Returns a job ID you can pass to CronDelete.

tools.name: EnterPlanMode
tools.description:
Use this tool proactively when you're about to start a non-trivial implementation task. Getting user sign-off on your approach before writing code prevents wasted effort and ensures alignment. This tool transitions you into plan mode where you can explore the codebase and design an implementation approach for user approval.

## When to Use This Tool

**Prefer using EnterPlanMode** for implementation tasks unless they're simple. Use it when ANY of these conditions apply:

1. **New Feature Implementation**: Adding meaningful new functionality
   - Example: "Add a logout button" - where should it go? What should happen on click?
   - Example: "Add form validation" - what rules? What error messages?

2. **Multiple Valid Approaches**: The task can be solved in several different ways
   - Example: "Add caching to the API" - could use Redis, in-memory, file-based, etc.
   - Example: "Improve performance" - many optimization strategies possible

3. **Code Modifications**: Changes that affect existing behavior or structure
   - Example: "Update the login flow" - what exactly should change?
   - Example: "Refactor this component" - what's the target architecture?

4. **Architectural Decisions**: The task requires choosing between patterns or technologies
   - Example: "Add real-time updates" - WebSockets vs SSE vs polling
   - Example: "Implement state management" - Redux vs Context vs custom solution

5. **Multi-File Changes**: The task will likely touch more than 2-3 files
   - Example: "Refactor the authentication system"
   - Example: "Add a new API endpoint with tests"

6. **Unclear Requirements**: You need to explore before understanding the full scope
   - Example: "Make the app faster" - need to profile and identify bottlenecks
   - Example: "Fix the bug in checkout" - need to investigate root cause

7. **User Preferences Matter**: The implementation could reasonably go multiple ways
   - If you would use AskUserQuestion to clarify the approach, use EnterPlanMode instead
   - Plan mode lets you explore first, then present options with context

## When NOT to Use This Tool

Only skip EnterPlanMode for simple tasks:
- Single-line or few-line fixes (typos, obvious bugs, small tweaks)
- Adding a single function with clear requirements
- Tasks where the user has given very specific, detailed instructions
- Pure research/exploration tasks (use the Agent tool instead)

## What Happens in Plan Mode

In plan mode, you'll:
1. Thoroughly explore the codebase using `find`/Glob, `grep`/Grep, and Read
2. Understand existing patterns and architecture
3. Design an implementation approach
4. Present your plan to the user for approval
5. Use AskUserQuestion if you need to clarify approaches
6. Exit plan mode with ExitPlanMode when ready to implement

## Examples

### GOOD - Use EnterPlanMode:
User: "Add user authentication to the app"
- Requires architectural decisions (session vs JWT, where to store tokens, middleware structure)

User: "Optimize the database queries"
- Multiple approaches possible, need to profile first, significant impact

User: "Implement dark mode"
- Architectural decision on theme system, affects many components

User: "Add a delete button to the user profile"

schema.name: EnterPlanMode
schema.description:
Use this tool proactively when you're about to start a non-trivial implementation task. Getting user sign-off on your approach before writing code prevents wasted effort and ensures alignment. This tool transitions you into plan mode where you can explore the codebase and design an implementation approach for user approval.

## When to Use This Tool

**Prefer using EnterPlanMode** for implementation tasks unless they're simple. Use it when ANY of these conditions apply:

1. **New Feature Implementation**: Adding meaningful new functionality
   - Example: "Add a logout button" - where should it go? What should happen on click?
   - Example: "Add form validation" - what rules? What error messages?

2. **Multiple Valid Approaches**: The task can be solved in several different ways
   - Example: "Add caching to the API" - could use Redis, in-memory, file-based, etc.
   - Example: "Improve performance" - many optimization strategies possible

3. **Code Modifications**: Changes that affect existing behavior or structure
   - Example: "Update the login flow" - what exactly should change?
   - Example: "Refactor this component" - what's the target architecture?

4. **Architectural Decisions**: The task requires choosing between patterns or technologies
   - Example: "Add real-time updates" - WebSockets vs SSE vs polling
   - Example: "Implement state management" - Redux vs Context vs custom solution

5. **Multi-File Changes**: The task will likely touch more than 2-3 files
   - Example: "Refactor the authentication system"
   - Example: "Add a new API endpoint with tests"

6. **Unclear Requirements**: You need to explore before understanding the full scope
   - Example: "Make the app faster" - need to profile and identify bottlenecks
   - Example: "Fix the bug in checkout" - need to investigate root cause

7. **User Preferences Matter**: The implementation could reasonably go multiple ways
   - If you would use AskUserQuestion to clarify the approach, use EnterPlanMode instead
   - Plan mode lets you explore first, then present options with context

## When NOT to Use This Tool

Only skip EnterPlanMode for simple tasks:
- Single-line or few-line fixes (typos, obvious bugs, small tweaks)
- Adding a single function with clear requirements
- Tasks where the user has given very specific, detailed instructions
- Pure research/exploration tasks (use the Agent tool instead)

## What Happens in Plan Mode

In plan mode, you'll:
1. Thoroughly explore the codebase using `find`/Glob, `grep`/Grep, and Read
2. Understand existing patterns and architecture
3. Design an implementation approach
4. Present your plan to the user for approval
5. Use AskUserQuestion if you need to clarify approaches
6. Exit plan mode with ExitPlanMode when ready to implement

tools.name: EnterWorktree
tools.description:
Use this tool ONLY when explicitly instructed to work in a worktree — either by the user directly, or by project instructions (CLAUDE.md / memory). This tool creates an isolated git worktree and switches the current session into it.

## When to Use

- The user explicitly says "worktree" (e.g., "start a worktree", "work in a worktree", "create a worktree", "use a worktree")
- CLAUDE.md or memory instructions direct you to work in a worktree for the current task

## When NOT to Use

- The user asks to create a branch, switch branches, or work on a different branch — use git commands instead
- The user asks to fix a bug or work on a feature — use normal git workflow unless worktrees are explicitly requested by the user or project instructions
- Never use this tool unless "worktree" is explicitly mentioned by the user or in CLAUDE.md / memory instructions

## Requirements

- Must be in a git repository, OR have WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks configured in settings.json
- Must not already be in a worktree session when creating a new worktree (`name`); switching into another existing worktree via `path` is allowed

## Behavior

- In a git repository: creates a new git worktree inside `.claude/worktrees/` on a new branch. The base ref is governed by the `worktree.baseRef` setting: `fresh` (default) branches from origin/<default-branch>; `head` branches from your current local HEAD
- Outside a git repository: delegates to WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks for VCS-agnostic isolation
- Switches the session's working directory to the new worktree
- Use ExitWorktree to leave the worktree mid-session (keep or remove). On session exit, if still in the worktree, the user will be prompted to keep or remove it

## Entering an existing worktree

Pass `path` instead of `name` to switch the session into a worktree that already exists (e.g., one you just created with `git worktree add`). On first entry from the launch directory, the path must appear in `git worktree list` for the repository that owns it — the current repository or, in a multi-repo workspace, a repository nested inside it; paths registered by neither are rejected. ExitWorktree will not remove a worktree entered this way; use `action: "keep"` to return to the original directory.

Switching with `path` also works when the session is already in a worktree (the previous worktree is left on disk, untouched, and only the new one is tracked for exit-time cleanup), and from agents whose working directory was pinned at launch (subagent isolation or explicit cwd). In both cases the target must be a worktree under `.claude/worktrees/` of the same repository, and from a pinned agent the switch only affects this agent, not the parent session. After a further switch, previously-visited worktrees are no longer writable — re-issue EnterWorktree with `path` to return to one.

## Parameters

- `name` (optional): A name for a new worktree. If neither `name` nor `path` is provided, a random name is generated.
- `path` (optional): Path to an existing worktree to enter instead of creating one — of the current repository, or (on first entry from the launch directory) of a repository nested inside it. Mutually exclusive with `name`.

tools.name: ExitPlanMode
tools.description:
Use this tool when you are in plan mode and have finished writing your plan to the plan file and are ready for user approval.

## How This Tool Works
- You should have already written your plan to the plan file specified in the plan mode system message
- This tool does NOT take the plan content as a parameter - it will read the plan from the file you wrote
- This tool simply signals that you're done planning and ready for the user to review and approve
- The user will see the contents of your plan file when they review it

## When to Use This Tool
IMPORTANT: Only use this tool when the task requires planning the implementation steps of a task that requires writing code. For research tasks where you're gathering information, searching files, reading files or in general trying to understand the codebase - do NOT use this tool.

## Before Using This Tool
Ensure your plan is complete and unambiguous:
- If you have unresolved questions about requirements or approach, use AskUserQuestion first (in earlier phases)
- Once your plan is finalized, use THIS tool to request approval

**Important:** Do NOT use AskUserQuestion to ask "Is this plan okay?" or "Should I proceed?" - that's exactly what THIS tool does. ExitPlanMode inherently requests user approval of your plan.

## Examples

1. Initial task: "Search for and understand the implementation of vim mode in the codebase" - Do not use the exit plan mode tool because you are not planning the implementation steps of a task.
2. Initial task: "Help me implement yank mode for vim" - Use the exit plan mode tool after you have finished planning the implementation steps of the task.
3. Initial task: "Add a new feature to handle user authentication" - If unsure about auth method (OAuth, JWT, etc.), use AskUserQuestion first, then use exit plan mode tool after clarifying the approach.

tools.name: ExitWorktree
tools.description:
Exit a worktree session created by EnterWorktree and return the session to the original working directory.

## Scope

This tool ONLY operates on worktrees created by EnterWorktree in this session. It will NOT touch:
- Worktrees you created manually with `git worktree add`
- Worktrees from a previous session (even if created by EnterWorktree then)
- The directory you're in if EnterWorktree was never called

If called outside an EnterWorktree session, the tool is a **no-op**: it reports that no worktree session is active and takes no action. Filesystem state is unchanged.

## When to Use

- The user explicitly asks to "exit the worktree", "leave the worktree", "go back", or otherwise end the worktree session
- Do NOT call this proactively — only when the user asks

## Parameters

- `action` (required): `"keep"` or `"remove"`
  - `"keep"` — leave the worktree directory and branch intact on disk. Use this if the user wants to come back to the work later, or if there are changes to preserve.
  - `"remove"` — delete the worktree directory and its branch. Use this for a clean exit when the work is done or abandoned.
- `discard_changes` (optional, default false): only meaningful with `action: "remove"`. If the worktree has uncommitted files or commits not on the original branch, the tool will REFUSE to remove it unless this is set to `true`. If the tool returns an error listing changes, confirm with the user before re-invoking with `discard_changes: true`.

## Behavior

- Restores the session's working directory to where it was before EnterWorktree
- Clears CWD-dependent caches (system prompt sections, memory files, plans directory) so the session state reflects the original directory
- If a tmux session was attached to the worktree: killed on `remove`, left running on `keep` (its name is returned so the user can reattach)
- Once exited, EnterWorktree can be called again to create a fresh worktree
